instruction: Candid studio photograph, close-up shot at eye-level with a shallow depth of field. In a minimalist indoor studio with a plain white background and blurred purple flowers in the foreground, three women are embraced in a tight hug. On the left, the woman with wavy light-brown hair (R3) in a white shirt smiles with her eyes closed. In the center, the woman with straight dark hair (R2) in a white top and denim jacket smiles gently with her eyes closed. On the right, the curly-haired woman (R1) in a white shirt smiles warmly. They are locked in a tight group hug, with the outer two women wrapping their arms around the center woman, leaning their heads together in a peaceful, affectionate moment. The lighting is bright and soft.
